name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 closed near 10,346 on 20 Nov, 5.2% below its high and 4.9% lower on the week
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,346 on 20 Nov, 4.9% lower on the week and 5.2% below its 52-week high of 10,911, past the 5% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). Its largest daily fall in the past five sessions was 1.8%, inside the 2.5% single-day line. The fall tracks the global equity sell-off that lifted the VIX to about 36 on 20 Nov.
for_you: UK-listed shares have fallen with global markets. Pension funds and ISAs with UK equity exposure are likely to show recent losses.
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.
